findings.claim: No universal compensation dominance; ordinary denoise loses much of the scalar beneficial correction.
findings.evidence: beta .25 scalar PSNR36.894890/LPIPS.07933719/flow.01064053; compensation35.847826/.11346453/.01336617; R35.917156/.11366326/.01332017. Compensation removes more than unwanted distortion in this case.
findings.inference_limit: One source; not a measured decomposition of independent VAE versus sampler errors.

findings.claim: Compression remains a negative example at moderate/large coefficients despite improvement versus the matched scalar baseline.
findings.inference_limit: A better method-to-method comparison is not proof of benefit over the usable restored input.

findings.claim: Identity controls favor compensation over scalar at every positive fixed beta, but both damage clean content and also degrade R.
findings.evidence: All four identity labels have exactly identical RGB hashes per family/beta. R PSNR55.683714 LPIPS.00155075 flow.00073214; beta .05 compensation54.382509/.00167122/.00080140, scalar53.492258/.00223845/.00090175. Original input is exactly the reference (MSE/LPIPS/flow zero); its displayed120dB is a metric cap.
findings.inference_limit: Four labels represent one identical sample, not four independent clean-source wins.

findings.claim: Near-clean beta .05 has a distortion/perceptual tradeoff, not uniform superiority.
findings.evidence: Compensation vs R PSNR−.3591..−.3696dB, LPIPS +.0000565..+.0000624, flow +.0000228..+.0000236; scalar PSNR−.4807..−.4956dB but LPIPS−.0002757..−.0002879 and flow−.0000442..−.0000449. Both still beat near-clean input by ~2.1..2.25dB.
findings.inference_limit: The four task-keyed noise draws share one source; poorer versus R does not imply poorer versus original noisy input.

findings.claim: Equal beta does not equal equal repair magnitude.
findings.evidence: The audit emits change_mse_vs_R for both families at every beta and sample; R+beta(G−V) and R+beta(G−R) have different residuals and clipping.
findings.inference_limit: Do not attribute matched-beta gains purely to a better direction without a separately declared magnitude-matched comparison.

findings.claim: Clipping contributes only to the measured final blend effect here; upstream internal clipping is already baked into both caches.
findings.evidence: Scalar is convex and has0 final clipped components for all84 entries; compensation reaches1.34818% clipped RGB components,2.63510% pixels, pre-final range[-.10191247,1.19988644]. Largest final-clamp pooled MSE reduction is2.56406326e-6.
findings.inference_limit: The float64 pre-final metrics are not true pre-internal-VAE-clamp measurements.

endpoint_caveats: Both families beta0 pixel-identical R. Scalar beta1 pixel-identical G. Compensation beta1 is not G.
Scalar beta.75 reproduces previous alpha.25 native full-RGB anchors. SR uses Q4 and is explicitly excluded.
All21 flow supports share hash in this grid; old references only attest same method/coverage plus endpoint metric reproduction, not original support tensor hash.
recommended_next_step: Keep this as a mechanism diagnostic and negative-control result. Preserve ordinary denoise/compression and identity/near-clean failures; any new mechanism study should predeclare repair-magnitude and no-harm comparisons plus source-isolated validation. No new run or coefficient is authorized/selected by this review.
limits: All 12 records come from one development source; identity four labels are exact duplicates; near-clean uses four task-keyed draws.
Same beta is not matched repair magnitude; both candidates' change MSE versus R is reported.
G and V are as returned after VAE internal clipping; pre/post clipping here refers only to the final RGB blend.
Compensation beta1 is clip(R+G-V), not G; scalar .75 matches full-RGB native alpha.25 anchor, not SR Q4 anchoring.
Current grid shares a hashed flow support. Historical H3/VAE has matching method/coverage and reproduced endpoint metrics, not a historical flow tensor hash.
No new pixel/model computation in this audit. Cache identity relies on recorded runtime file/array checks and archive hashes.
Raw warm start stays fixed; subtracting VAE(R) is a diagnostic, not independent sampler-error attribution.
No coefficient selected, no deployment or generalization claim, no semantic/factual preservation measurement.

tests.scope: stdlib read-only evidence and semantic rejection tests; no model/metric computation
